paite: Aaron tapate pawl khendan hichibang ahi, Aaron tapate Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi uh.
heading: Siampute Nagotna

paite: Nadab leh Abihu bel apa uh sang in asi masa ua; ta anei kei uh; huaiziak in Eleazar leh Ithamarte'n siampu nna asem uhi.
David in Eleazar tapa Zadok leh Ithamar tapa Ahimelekte toh anasepdan ding uh ahawmsak hi.
Ithamar suante sang in Eleazar suan makaipen a pang atamzaw uh; hichibang in akhen ua; Eleazar suan ah, inkuan makaipen sawm-le-guk a hi uh; Ithamar suan ah, inkuan makaipen giat ahi uhi.
Eleazar suan a mi leh Ithamar suan a mite lak ah, mun siangthou a miliante leh Pathian miliante a om tuaktuak uh ahih ziak in aisan in, amaute akhen uhi.

Huan Levi mi, laigelhmi Nethaneel tapa Shemaiah in kumpipa, milian, siampu Zadok, Abiathar tapa Ahimelek, siampute leh Levite inko makaipente mitmuh in agelh a; inkuan pipa khat tan Eleazar tung ah apuk a, khat bel Ithamar tung ah apuk hi.
Huchi in aisan akhatveina bel Jehoarib tung ah atu a, anihveina Jedaiah tung ah;
athumveina Harim tung ah, aliveina Seorim tung ah;
angaveina Makijah tung ah, agukveina Mijamin tung ah;
asagihveina Hakoz tung ah, agiatveina Abijah tung ah;
akuaveina Jeshua tung ah, asawmveina Shekaniah tung ah;
asawm-le-khatveina Eliashib tung ah, asawm-le-nihveina Jakim tung ah;
asawm-le-thumveina Huppah tung ah, asawm-le-liveina Jeshebeab tung ah;
asawm-le-ngaveina Bilgah tung ah, asawm-le-gukveina Immer tung ah;
asawm-le-sagihveina Hezir tung ah, asawm-le-giatveina Happizzez tung ah;
asawm-le-kuaveina Pethahiah tung ah, asawmnihveina Jehezekel tung ah;
asawmnih-le-khatveina Jakin tung ah, asawmnih-le-nihveina Gamul tung ah;
asawmnih-le-thumveina Delaiah tung ah, asawmnih-le-liveina Maaziah tung ah atu hi.
Huai bel TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in apu uh Aaron thu ana piak, TOUPA insung a nna asepdan ding ana sehdan ahi hi.
Levi suan dangte lak ah; Amram tapate lak ah Shubael ahi; Shubael tapate lak ah Jehdeiah.
heading: Levite Mite Phakzah

paite: Rehabiah lam ah; Rehabaihte lak ah amakaipen Isshiah ahi.
Izharte lak ah Shelomoth; Shelomoth tapate lak ah Jahath,
Hebron tapate, a-upapen Jeriah ahi a, anihna Amariah, athumna Jahaziel, alina Jokameam ahi.
Uzziel tapate lak a mi Mikah; Mikah tapate lak a mi Shamir ahi.
Mikah unaupa Isshiah ahi a; Isshiah tapate lak a mi Zekariah ahi.
Merari tapate bel Mahli leh Mushi ahi ua; Jaaziah tapate lak a mi Beno ahi.
Merari suante, Jaaziah lak ah Beno, Shoham, Zakkur leh Ibrite ahi uh.
Mahli lak ah, Eleazar ahi a, ama'n tapa anei kei.
Kish lak ah, Kish tapa Jerahmeel ahi.
Mushi suante bel, Mahli, Eder leh Jerimothte ahi uh. Hiaite bel Levite suante lak a a-inkuan ua makai lianpente ahi uhi.
Hiai inkuan chih a lianpen leh naupangpente'n leng Aaron ta a-unaute uh bang in, agam tan ding uh, kumpipa David, Zadok, Ahimelek, siampu leh Levite inko makaipente mitmuh in ai asan sam uhi.
